name_zh: 扎耶德/阿联酋联邦：部落联邦制与石油现代化
name_en: Zayed/UAE Federation: Tribal Federalism & Oil Modernization
description_zh: 谢赫·扎耶德·本·苏尔坦·阿勒纳哈扬 (1918-2004) 阿联酋建国之父/首任总统 (1971-2004)/七酋长国联邦/石油财富分配/部落共识/现代化/迪拜/阿布扎比/外劳/免税/福利/教育/医疗/女性权利/海湾合作委员会/中立调解。核心模式：部落联邦制石油国家 — 酋长/部落/联邦/石油/福利/现代化/外交平衡/软实力。体现 M170 部落联邦制 — 以"酋长共识+石油福利分配+部落自治+联邦外交"四位一体，在部落传统/石油财富/现代化/区域地缘四重张力中构建海湾联邦奇迹。
description_en: Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan (1918-2004) UAE founding father/first President (1971-2004)/seven emirates federation/oil wealth distribution/tribal consensus/modernization/Dubai/Abu Dhabi/expatriates/tax-free/welfare/education/healthcare/women's rights/GCC/neutral mediation. Core model: Tribal Federalism Oil State — emirs/tribes/federation/oil/welfare/modernization/diplomatic balance/soft power. Exemplifies M170 Tribal Federalism — quaternity of 'emir consensus + oil welfare distribution + tribal autonomy + federal diplomacy' building Gulf federal miracle amid quadruple tensions of tribal tradition/oil wealth/modernization/regional geopolitics.
reason_zh: 阿联酋非单纯石油酋长国，而是"酋长共识+石油福利+部落自治"三位一体联邦实验。七酋长以部落共识建立联邦，石油财富支撑全民福利/免税/高收入，部落自治在联邦框架内保留。M170 区隔于 M170 双语联邦(喀麦隆)、M181 边境地带(乌克兰)、M183 原住民自决(玻利维亚)，核心在于"酋长共识即联邦契约+石油福利即社会契约+部落自治即治理基石"的海湾部落联邦范式。
reason_en: UAE not mere oil emirate but 'emir consensus + oil welfare + tribal autonomy' trinity federal experiment. Seven emirs built federation via tribal consensus, oil wealth funds universal welfare/tax-free/high income, tribal autonomy preserved within federal framework. M170 distinct from M170 Bilingual Federalism (Cameroon), M181 Borderland (Ukraine), M183 Indigenous Self-Determination (Bolivia), core: 'emir consensus as federal contract + oil welfare as social contract + tribal autonomy as governance foundation' Gulf tribal federal paradigm.
steps_zh: 酋长共识建立联邦：1971 七酋长/拉希德/扎耶德/联邦最高委员会/总统/副总统/部长会议/联邦国民议会/共识决策
石油福利全民契约：石油/天然气 90%+ 出口/人均 GDP 世界前列/免费医疗/教育/住房/补贴/无所得税/福利即合法性

Oil welfare universal contract: oil/gas 90%+ exports/GDP per capita world top/free healthcare/education/housing/subsidies/no income tax/welfare = legitimacy
Gulf diplomacy & soft power: GCC/mediation/Qatar/Yemen/Sudan/Libya/Palestine/humanitarian aid/investment/ADFD/neutral brand

expected_zh: 以"酋长共识+石油福利+部落自治+联邦外交"四位一体，在部落传统/石油财富/现代化/区域地缘四重张力中构建海湾联邦奇迹，为部落联邦石油国家提供治理范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'emir consensus + oil welfare + tribal autonomy + federal diplomacy' builds Gulf federal miracle amid quadruple tensions, providing governance paradigm for tribal federal oil states.
